subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should agent-visible file paths keep home-relative display by default, switch to full absolute paths, or add a documented opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and the repository has a high bar for new config/env surface, so automation should not choose the display contract.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` as the compact default while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Render agent-visible file paths as full absolute paths by default and update prompts, docs, shared helpers, and tests consistently.

options.title: Add Explicit Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep current defaults but add a documented opt-in setting for users who need absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` as the compact default while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across the agent-runtime and terminal-core owner boundaries and is the best available owner for choosing the product-facing display contract.
